Experience Bristol's creative energy from this modern two-bedroom first-floor apartment on Cheltenham Road. Set within a building featuring a one-of-a-kind mural by Andrew Burns Colwill, this home blends hotel-style comforts with artistic charm.

The apartment offers two well-appointed bedrooms with premium bedding and storage. The open-plan living area includes a smart TV, comfortable seating, and high-speed Wi-Fi, while smart lighting and voice-controlled speakers enhance the ambience. A fully equipped kitchen ensures convenience, and an on-site laundry room adds extra practicality.

Throughout the building, prints of Andrew Burns Colwill's original sketches showcase the area's deep connection to Bristol's renowned street art scene.

Premium Services
Enhance your stay with our dedicated concierge team and personal service app, offering:
Tour desk assistance for local experiences, dining, and transport bookings.
Optional housekeeping and linen refresh for added convenience.
Seamless in-app service upgrades and requests.

The Neighbourhood
Located on Cheltenham Road, you're in the heart of Bristol's creative district, just steps from:
Stokes Croft - Bristol's hub for independent shops, street art, and nightlife.
Gloucester Road - known for its diverse restaurants and cafés.
Bristol city centre, SS Great Britain, and Clifton Suspension Bridge.

Guest Access & House Rules
Guests have full access to the apartment and all amenities.
Quiet hours from 10 PM to 7 AM.
Smoking permitted in designated outdoor areas only.
No pets allowed.

Security & Parking
State-of-the-art security system for peace of mind.
Paid on-street parking available, and free parking is within 10 min.
